veranderings.voor: Growwe klere se drade wys duidelik naas gladde vel
veranderings.na: Die drade van growwe klere wys duidelik langs gladde vel
veranderings.rede: 'naas' is formal for Grade 4 and 'langs' is the everyday word; 'die drade van growwe klere' reads more naturally than the stacked 'se' possessive.
